subject: general
question: The Buddha belonged to a small gana known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sakya gana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

The Buddha belonged to the **Sakya gana**, which was a small republic located in the **foothills of the Himalayas **in present-day Nepal.

__
 
• The Sakya gana was ruled by a council of elders known as the **Gana Parishad **and was known for its adherence to **Vedic traditions and rituals.**
 
• The Buddha's father,** Suddhodana**, was the ruler of the **Sakya gana **and belonged to the** Kshatriya caste**, which was associated with** military and administrative duties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Avanti gana** was a larger republic located in present-day **Madhya Pradesh** and was known for its **administrative and economic prosperity **under the rule of **King Pradyota.**
 
• **The Kuru gana** was an **ancient Vedic tribe** that was mentioned in the **Mahabharata **and was associated with the **Kuru dynasty,** which ruled over the kingdom of **Hastinapura.**
 
• **The Panchal gana **was a confederation of five tribes located in present-day **Uttar Pradesh** and was known for its military prowess and contribution to the epic battles in the Mahabharata.
